title: LoRa TDMA V2 Join Hello relay envelope (proposed contract)

event_id.description: MUST equal gateway_id + ':' + gateway_epoch + ':' + event_seq (semantic equality validated by consumers). Stable on QoS1 retransmission/replay.

gateway_epoch.description: Unique boot epoch; regenerate on Gateway reboot, never on MQTT reconnect. Offline queued events retain original epoch.

event_seq.description: Decimal uint64 counter scoped to gateway_epoch; semantic integer <= 18446744073709551615 and no wrap/reuse.

observed_at.description: Event occurrence time (UTC Z) only when a defensible time source exists. Null when unknown; never silently backfill with ingest time.

radio_rx_monotonic_us.description: Gateway-local monotonic microseconds; meaningful only within gateway_epoch. Do not compare across boots.

buffered.description: Indicates offline queue/replay path; QoS1 DUP flag is NOT a business dedup key. Event identity never changes after buffering.

target_gw_id.description: Numeric Gateway ID (0x01..0xFE) targeted by the joining node in UP_JOIN_HELLO byte 7. Must match receiving gateway assignment.

raw_frame_hex.description: Exact 68-byte on-air UP_JOIN_HELLO (0x45) frame hex-encoded (136 hexadecimal characters).

rssi.description: Received signal strength indication in dBm measured by Gateway SX1276.

snr.description: Signal-to-noise ratio in dB measured by Gateway SX1276.

description: DRAFT MQTT v1 Join Hello relay payload; schema checks local shape, not topic authorization, replay, clock freshness, state transitions or cryptographic HMAC. Cross-team review pending (#221).
